query: SELECT c.id, c.claim_number, c.status, c.updated_at, a.id as assessment_id, a.stage_reached, a.processing_time_ms, a.created_at as assessment_started FROM claims c LEFT JOIN ai_assessments a ON a.claim_id = c.id WHERE c.claim_number LIKE '%B915065B%' LIMIT 1;
